annotations.title: Create a trade link for a person

description: A pre-filled predictDEX ticket URL (event, market, outcome, side, amount) for a person to review and sign in their own wallet. Opening it executes nothing. Use this when you have no wallet or need human confirmation.

amount.description: USD to spend for BUY, shares for SELL

market.description: Market id or conditionId (defaults to the event's main market)

name: create_trade_link
